classification_rules.source_geometry: Supported only as a geometric observation when an exact candidate intersects source geometry by positive area; no administrative or legal resolution is implied.
classification_rules.physical_water_or_historic_course: JRC GSW v1.5 supplies water-pixel observations within each candidate for 1984–2024 occurrence and 2024 seasonality; exact bank/course, waterbody type, historic course, cause, and boundary authority remain unresolved.
classification_rules.processing_cause: Unresolved unless a specific processing step and mechanism are reproduced.
classification_rules.boundary_authority: Unresolved absent the completed demarcation record or authoritative modern line source.

boundary_authority.finding: The 1928 joint Kakeri Final Act documents demarcation by chords joining 47 beacons; the 1931 exchange records both governments accepting the demarcation and description. This component bbox is east and south of printed beacon 47 only by coarse raw-coordinate screening. The treaty framework follows the Okavango river sector after beacon 47, but the historical/current river median or bank at this component has not been reconstructed. Candidate-specific exact line and territorial authority remain unresolved.
